create.name: Richard Rudd
create.bio:
Richard Rudd is an English spiritual teacher, poet and author, best known as the founder of the Gene Keys, a contemplative system built on the 64 hexagrams of the I Ching. He traces the work to a powerful spiritual experience at the age of 29 and spent seven years writing the book that set it out. Before that he took a master's degree in metaphysics and literature at Edinburgh, travelled widely in Asia and the Americas, worked in film in Australia and trained as a Chi Kung teacher in Thailand. He won the FISH international poetry prize in 2006 and lives in Devon with his family. His earlier books on Human Design remain in print.

The Gene Keys are worked with through a personal profile drawn from the date, time and place of birth. Rather than offering fixed answers, Richard asks students to sit patiently with each key, letting its meaning unfold over weeks and months, a practice he calls contemplation. Each key is described as a shadow that can mature into a gift and, in time, a fuller spiritual quality. He teaches through books, the self-study Golden Path courses, long online retreats and occasional in-person workshops, and he has been named on the Watkins list of influential living spiritual figures.

books.title: The Gene Keys: Embracing Your Higher Purpose
books.author: Richard Rudd
books.description: The central text of the Gene Keys, with a chapter for each of the 64 keys tracing how a habitual pattern can ripen into a gift and a higher quality. It is meant to be read slowly and returned to, either alongside a personal profile or on its own as a contemplative companion.

books.title: Contemplation: Expand Time, Transform Your Emotions and Unleash Your Natural Brilliance
books.author: Richard Rudd
books.description: A short practical guide to the three-step practice of contemplation that sits underneath the Gene Keys, republished by Hay House in 2026 with a new preface. It shows how to slow down, watch emotional reactions and let insight arise from patient attention.

books.title: The 64 Ways: Personal Contemplations on the Gene Keys
books.author: Richard Rudd
books.description: Sixty-four personal reflections, one on each Gene Key, written in a looser and more poetic voice than the main book. Each piece is an invitation to sit with a key rather than an explanation of it.

books.title: The Seven Sacred Seals: Portals To Grace
books.author: Richard Rudd
books.description: A mystical study of seven pairs of Gene Keys that Richard presents as gateways to grace and higher states of consciousness. It reads as a visionary meditation on humanity's spiritual future.

books.title: Dare to be Divine: A Journey into the Miraculous
books.author: Richard Rudd
books.description: A tour of the 64 Siddhis, the highest qualities described in the Gene Keys, each written as a portrait of a different face of awakened life. The style is lyrical, drawing on stories and images from many traditions.

books.title: Genius: A Guide to your Activation Sequence (Gene Keys Golden Path)
books.author: Richard Rudd
books.description: The first of three Golden Path guidebooks, walking readers through the four keys in their profile that relate to life purpose. It can be used with the online course or worked through alone.

books.title: Prosperity: A Guide to your Pearl Sequence (Gene Keys Golden Path)
books.author: Richard Rudd
books.description: The third Golden Path guidebook, on vocation, simplicity and service. It explores a view of prosperity rooted in contribution and collaboration rather than accumulation.

books.title: Human Design - The Revelation: A Guide to Basic Concepts, Centres Types and Definition
books.author: Richard Rudd
books.description: An introduction to the core building blocks of Human Design, from the energy centres to the types and how definition works in a chart. Written from Richard's years of teaching the system before he developed the Gene Keys.

books.title: Human Design - Circuitry: The Complete Guide to Circuits, Channels and Gates
books.author: Richard Rudd
books.description: A detailed reference to the circuits, channels and gates of the Human Design chart, aimed at students who already know the basics. It explains how the different circuit groups shape the way a person engages with others.

courses.title: The Gene Keys Master Numbers
courses.description: A weekend workshop at Omega in Rhinebeck, New York, on the five master numbers in the Gene Keys (11, 22, 33, 44 and 55), each approached as a doorway to a different stage of inner and collective change. Sessions mix guided meditation, voice and body practice, contemplation and discussion, and suit newcomers as well as long-time students.

courses.title: The Pearl Sequence Online Retreat (2027)
courses.description: A four-month live online retreat with Richard and a team of hosts, working through each participant's Pearl Sequence, the part of the profile concerned with vocation and prosperity. It runs with weekly live sessions and monthly themes, and Richard has said this is the last time he will lead it online.

courses.title: The Activation Sequence
courses.description: The first self-study course of the Golden Path, guiding students through the four keys in their profile linked to life purpose. It includes a step-by-step contemplative guide, recorded webinars and musical meditations.

courses.title: The Venus Sequence
courses.description: The second Golden Path course, looking at relationships and the emotional patterns traced in each person's profile. Students work through webinars, contemplations and meditations at their own pace.

courses.title: The Pearl Sequence
courses.description: The third Golden Path self-study course, on vocation, simplicity and creative collaboration as the basis of prosperity. Lifetime access to the guide, webinars and audios.

courses.title: The Delta Programme
courses.description: A group course in which seven people meet over seven weeks to explore seven themes together, aiming at shared harmony and collective change. It includes audios, mudras and contemplation videos by Richard, and can be replayed with new groups.

free_resources.title: New to the Gene Keys
free_resources.description: A free three-day introductory course that gives newcomers a first look at their profile and the practice of contemplation, with one day each on purpose, love and prosperity. A free account is needed to enrol.

free_resources.title: The Pulse newsletter
free_resources.description: A free weekly email with resources for contemplating the Gene Key of the week, following the yearly cycle through all 64 keys.
